title: Automatic Trails
description: Automatic Trails is a navigation ability in the Deep-Link Breadcrumb Trails database. Builds breadcrumbs automatically from the URL path. Path segments become crumbs; the trail updates on every navigation. It takes URLs and produces trails. Tunable parameters: per page. Guarantee: the trail always matches the URL.

fields.mechanism: Path segments become crumbs; the trail updates on every navigation.
fields.guarantees: the trail always matches the URL

title: Deep-Link Restore
